# PathSnap: Cleaning Report (auto-generated by `scripts/run_cleaning.py`)

Cleaning **never deletes rows**: every GPS fix still needs a prediction. It adds metres (per-trip UTM), segment / stop ids and quality flags. Thresholds are hand-set in `src/pathsnap/cleaning.py` and explained in `docs/DATA_QUALITY_NOTES.md`.

## Thresholds

| name | value | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| SEGMENT_GAP_S | 120 s | a longer time gap starts a new segment |
| MAX_SPEED_MPS | 70 m/s | faster steps get `is_fast_step` (speed not trusted) |
| STOP_WINDOW / STOP_RADIUS_M | 60 fixes / 30 m | moved less than this = stopped |
| OFF_NETWORK_M | 50 m | fix farther than this from every road |
| FAR_FROM_ROUTE_M | 50 m | fix farther than this from its reference route (label check) |
| EXCLUDE_TRIP_FAR_FRAC | 25% | trip dropped from training above this share of far fixes |

## Road networks

* Zero-length arcs (never candidates): 106.
* Geometric duplicate arcs mapped to a canonical arc id: 1953. Reference-route entries that use a non-canonical duplicate: 3 (score predictions on `canonical_arc_id` so identical roads count as the same).
* Route breaks kept as-is and flagged (`break_before`): 14.

## Trips excluded from training

| partition | trip_id | reason |
|---|---|---|
| train | 00000033 | 59% of fixes > 50 m from the reference route |
| train | 00000054 | 87% of fixes > 50 m from the reference route |

Excluded trips stay in `data/processed` with all flags. For student_test this only affects the "reliable fixes only" metric; metrics on all fixes are reported too.

## Output files (`data/processed/<partition>/<trip_id>/`)

* `track.csv.gz`: one row per raw fix (same order). `fix_idx, lon, lat, t, t_rel, dt_prev, x, y, step_m, speed_mps, segment_id, is_spike, is_fast_step, is_stop, stop_id, d_net_m, is_off_network` are **label-free**. `d_route_m, is_far_from_route, label_reliable` use the route and must never be model inputs.
* `nodes.csv.gz`: `node_id, lon, lat, x, y`.
* `arcs.csv.gz`: `arc_id, from_node, to_node, length_m, is_self_loop, is_zero_length, canonical_arc_id, is_duplicate, in_largest_scc, is_candidate`.
* `route.csv.gz`: `seq, arc_id, canonical_arc_id, break_before, is_uturn, is_revisit`.
* `meta.json`: UTM zone, counts, exclusion decision and thresholds.
